declaration_meanings.sub_kronecker: Tensoring a difference in the first factor equals the difference of tensor products.
declaration_meanings.kronecker_sub: Tensoring a difference in the second factor equals the difference of tensor products.
declaration_meanings.first_idempotent: Stage1 embeds two idempotent factor projectors as an idempotent ambient projector.
declaration_meanings.second_multiplication: Stage2 affine embedding preserves multiplication when its fixed factor is idempotent.
declaration_meanings.second_idempotent: Stage2 embeds an idempotent local projector as an idempotent ambient projector.
declaration_meanings.first_absorption: Stage1 preserves the displayed local absorption equation.
declaration_meanings.second_absorption: Stage2 preserves the displayed local absorption equation.
declaration_meanings.first_residual: Stage1 residual is the exact local matrix difference tensored with the fixed projector.
declaration_meanings.second_residual: Stage2 background cancels and its residual is the fixed projector tensored with the local difference.
declaration_meanings.second_zero: Stage2 local zero is its nonzero (I-P) tensor I background.
declaration_meanings.second_one: Stage2 local full space is full ambient identity.
declaration_meanings.second_complement_formula: Stage2 projector equals identity minus P tensor the complement of the local projector.
declaration_meanings.source_data_front: The source data front between stages is (I-P) tensor (I-Q).
declaration_meanings.target_data_front: The target data front is the same exact tensor-complement residual.
declaration_meanings.second_source_growth: Stage2 source data growth is P tensor (I-Q).
declaration_meanings.second_target_growth: Stage2 target data growth is P tensor (I-Q).
declaration_meanings.data_target_endpoint: Final target data gauge is identity minus P tensor Q.
declaration_meanings.first_auxiliary_exterior: Stage1 full-minus-local-end exterior is I tensor (I-Q).
declaration_meanings.second_auxiliary_exterior: Stage2 old-full-minus-final-endpoint exterior is the exact matrix (I-P) tensor I. Its later interpretation as an involutive partial swap uses the separate address-gauge theorem.
declaration_meanings.second_auxiliary_complementary_endpoints: Stage2 original auxiliary endpoint is complementary to its nonzero source gauge.
declaration_meanings.paid_correction_residual: The paid final data correction has exact residual P tensor Q.
